ENGAGEMENT APPROACH:
We engage employees via a global employee survey every 
18-24 months. 
We administer an online suggestion box and facilitate a 
direct channel between employees and our CEO or any 
executive staff member through the submission of questions 
(anonymously, if preferred) prior to our quarterly company 
meeting, which our CEO can respond to onstage.
We engage with prospective employees through the careers 
section of NVIDIA’s website and through university, diversity, 
and professional recruiting events. 
We also offer an employee referral program.
